messages:
cam: I opened a tiny PR to add a Dedicated provisioning 'Fallback Runbook' with a short smoke checklist and example telemetry. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4477

maria: nice. can you paste the smoke test and telemetry bits here for quick review?

cam: pasted below. keeping it short.

```yaml
fallback_runbook_example:
  trigger:
    metric: p99_latency_ms
    threshold_ms: 180
  guard:
    type: compatibility_check  # returns {ok: bool, reason: str}
    requires:
      - tool_calls
      - structured_outputs
  actions:
    - route_to: dedicated-eu-fallback
    - set_rate_limit: 12rps
    - switch_model_variant: redwood/gpt-small-quant  # reduced-capability variant
  smoke_checks:
    - curl: |
        curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
          -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
          -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-small-quant","input":"#toolcall test","tools":[{"name":"echo","schema":{}}]}'
    - expect: "function_call_ok"
  telemetry_labels:
    - routing.fallback: eu-180ms-playbook
    - model.variant: gpt-small-quant
```

leo: +1 on the compatibility_check returning a tuple. Runtime: make sure the guard also checks KV cache schema compatibility (context length and cache keys). otherwise warmup will spike latency.

jin: docs nit: replace "switch_model_variant" key with "reduced_variant" in the YAML to avoid implying mutability of the canonical model. also add a one-line prose description under the example explaining each step for non-eng readers.

anita: ops request: include a recommended telemetry retention for fallback traces (72h) and add sample query to filter fallback events in our tracing UI. e.g., `service:inference AND tags.routing.fallback:eu-180ms-playbook`.

docs-bot: link-check: docs/dedicated/provisioning-runbook.md line 22: internal link /handbook/legal/sla.pdf flagged as private. Consider linking to /handbook/sales/enterprise-sla-summary for public-facing docs.

cam: thanks all. I'll change the YAML key to `reduced_variant`, add a 1-paragraph plain-English explainer, include the KV cache warmup note, and swap the SLA link to the sales summary. Pushing update now.

maria: will take a final look after update; looks straightforward. :thumbsup:

leo: non-blocking: suggest adding a short note about alerting thresholds vs. runbook triggers (alerts might be more conservative).

cam: added that note and the sample tracing query to the checklist. If no objections I'll merge after the link fix and wording tweaks.

jin: lgtm after key rename.

anita: approved from ops side.

cam: merged. thanks everyone.
